counterfactuals.change: q-34823 scale1: replace matches A with matches C while keeping dimensions and excluded B unchanged; visible A pivot removed and C pivot restored.

counterfactuals.justification: Nonzero scalar multiplication preserves linear dependence, dimensions and pivot count, the quantities defined in tutorial 4151.

shortcut_probes.cue: B is dimension-excluded in rank-3 three-matrix family with shape multiset {2x4,3x4,5x5}
shortcut_probes.subgroup: Exact runner batch after delivery filtering: q-139965, eligible A and C
shortcut_probes.strategy: Always include A; inspect only C for rank 3, then choose the encoded subset. Never inspect A.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: The full catalog has three eligible nonempty subsets A, C, AC, so hardcoding A would succeed in 2/3 of those decision cases (observed 4/6 in this same subgroup). The exact delivered batch reaches 2/2, skipping A inspection in every subgroup member. Native learner grader accepts both shortcut responses. This is a finite batch-selection defect, not a universal generator defect and not a demand to realize every subset.

shortcut_probes.cue: Same recognizable dimension-excluded-B subgroup in larger catalog
shortcut_probes.strategy: Always include A; inspect only C.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Comparison baseline 2/3 over the three nonempty subsets. Two C-only controls defeat this strategy; larger sampler coverage cannot waive the batch defect.

shortcut_probes.subgroup: Entire exact runner batch (three radio records; two checkbox records excluded)
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Uniform guessing among five displayed options gives baseline 0.2. None of the three radio records succeeds in the actual rendered DOM; no first-position predictor established.

shortcut_probes.cue: Matrix identity in the five-matrix q-139958 presentation
shortcut_probes.strategy: Always choose C, the source winner.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Baseline is uniform five-choice guessing. C and E both qualify in different records, so the source winner is not universally predictive. The runner batch contains only one such record; that singleton alone is not treated as a new defect.

shortcut_probes.cue: Visible independent pivots in triangular/echelon matrices
shortcut_probes.strategy: Reject B by dimensions; count A and C independent pivots and compare with 5.
shortcut_probes.conclusion: Baseline is random choice among the five radio options. Inspecting the pivot structure is the lesson operation, not an incidental shortcut.
